trigger.title: users see errors on the shop

symptoms_summary: Users see 500 errors on the shop (frontend 5xx rate ~9.4%, above the 5% threshold). The errors originate in frontend's gRPC calls to the cart service (GetCart/AddItem failing with gRPC status 14 UNAVAILABLE, ECONNREFUSED to cart:7070), which propagate up through frontend-proxy as HTTP 500s.

root_cause.cause: The cart container exited (exit code 0, graceful shutdown) at 12:14:56 and was not restarted, so gRPC connections to cart:7070 are refused and every cart-dependent request fails.

confidence_notes: 1 evidence item(s) only partially matched (values real, wording reordered)

evidence.detail: Detector flagged the cart container as stopped, matching the alert time.
Container state confirms cart is exited with a clean exit code 0 (graceful shutdown, not OOM or crash), no restarts.
Cart's own logs show a graceful shutdown sequence at 12:14:56, the moment it stopped serving.
Trace shows the error starts at frontend's gRPC call to cart: ECONNREFUSED to 172.18.0.21:7070, propagating up as HTTP 500.
evidence.reference: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 172.18.0.21:7070

evidence.detail: Error origin analysis confirms errors start at frontend's CartService/GetCart and AddItem calls with gRPC status 14 (UNAVAILABLE).

alternatives_ruled_out: Application bug in frontend: frontend's own error ratio (0.147) is at/below its 30-min baseline (0.169) and all errors trace back to the cart dependency
Resource exhaustion: cart was not OOM-killed and exited with code 0
Traffic surge: frontend request rate is normal and other services show no errors
Latency issue: p95 latencies are at or below baseline for all services

recommended_action.reason: The cart container exited cleanly (exit code 0) and was not restarted; restarting it will restore cart:7070 and clear the UNAVAILABLE/ECONNREFUSED errors. Investigate why it shut down (e.g. missing restart policy or an external stop) to prevent recurrence.

prevention: Ensure the cart container has a restart policy (e.g. unless-stopped) and an orchestrator health check so it is automatically restarted after an unexpected stop; add an alert on container state changes to detect stops before user impact.
safety_note: Diagnosis only: read-only tools, no feature-flag access, no changes made. Any action requires human approval and goes through the Action API (Hands).
